tier_definitions.full_pretraining_ambition: planning-scale scratch pretraining; ranges are project planning envelopes and held-out-curve controlled, not claimed universal optima
tier_definitions.meaningful_learned_campaign: enough unique data to compare a scale scientifically without the result being dominated by immediate data starvation; must also meet source-family diversity
tier_definitions.mechanics_qualification: prove construction, optimization, memory/checkpoint/inference mechanics; may use bounded fixtures and must not be advertised as learned quality
tier_definitions.short_scientific_training: bounded learned trajectory sufficient to observe optimization/quality direction, not a pretraining claim
